Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)]]: Cher on stage at Wembley Arena, London, in 1992 (her Love Hurts Tour), seen from behind in a backless costume, with the tattoo on her backside visible. Cropped to remove the agency's credit strip on the right (428 by 653 pixels).

Photo: Brian Rasic/REX Features (Shutterstock), Wembley Arena, London, 1992. Agency reference 199891B, captioned "Cher Performing at the Wembley Arena, London, Britain - 1992" and credited "MUST CREDIT PHOTOS BY: REX/Brian Rasic". Copy supplied by Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced press photograph of the performer whose well-known backside tattoo the card's lore jokes about. It is used only to identify that reference beside the card on [[Jokes]], with full credit to the photographer and agency.
